name: フォーム優先アウトバウンド
tagline: Form-first B2B outreach for Japan: prep daily, send only on your GO
description: Runs B2B prospecting through web forms rather than cold emails, the way many Japanese buyers prefer. Each day it lines up prospect research and drafts the message, a quality gate reviews the copy, and nothing goes out until you approve it with a GO. Every submitted touch lands in the CRM for a weekly review.
author: isle_claude
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
